args.message: The table shows each city's revenue next to its region's total revenue. Revenue is the sum of order amounts across all orders, with no filter on order status. Region and city come from each order's customer. Orders whose customer has no known region go into a blank region group. The Paris customer has no known region, so Paris falls into this group. The group also includes orders with no known city, whether because the customer record is missing or has no city. The blank region's total is 1,193.30. "Oslo" shows up under both North and South because customers are recorded with that city in both regions; each is kept as its own row.
